subject: history_social
passage: Construction of the Taj Mahal in Agra, India, began in 1632, the year after the death of Mumtaz Mahal, the wife of the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan. By the time the main tomb was essentially finished around 1643, thousands of workers ______ on it for more than a decade. The project was still not complete, however: work on the surrounding buildings and gardens continued for about ten more years.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: The phrase "By the time the main tomb was essentially finished around 1643" sets a point in the past. Work that went on before and up to that past point needs the past perfect, so "had worked" is correct.
explanation.A: Incorrect. "Working" is not a main verb, so the clause "thousands of workers working on it" would have no main verb.
explanation.B: Correct. The past perfect "had worked" shows that the work took place before the past moment named by "By the time ... 1643."
explanation.C: Incorrect. The present tense "work" doesn't fit events that the passage places in the 1630s and 1640s.
explanation.D: Incorrect. The present perfect "have worked" connects the past to the present, but this action ended at a past point, "around 1643."
